home.title: TAB-1 dashboards
home.intro: Build what your Apollo TAB-1 tablet shows. You pick the cards, and you see the tablet's screen while you work.
home.not_sent: Dashboards are not sent to tablets yet. That needs tablet software that has not been released. Everything you build here is saved and will be ready when it is.
home.tablets_none: No TAB-1 tablet found in Home Assistant yet. You can still build dashboards.
home.empty_text: A dashboard is a set of pages for your tablet, such as Home or Bedroom. Each page holds cards, such as a light switch or a thermostat.
home.step_1: Press "Create a dashboard". You get one empty page called Home.
home.step_2: Press "Add card", pick a card, then pick the device it controls.
home.step_3: Add more cards and pages. Everything is saved as you go.
home.create_failed: The dashboard could not be created: {message}
home.not_shown_one: {items} is not shown on the tablet.
home.not_shown_many: {items} are not shown on the tablet.
home.kept_waiting: A change you made here is waiting for your choice. Press Edit to decide.
home.kept_unsaved: A change you made here is not saved yet. It keeps trying while this browser page is open.
home.yaml_note: This dashboard is kept in a YAML file, so it can only be changed in that file. You can look at it here.
home.advanced_hint: Community cards, and permission for cards that control locks or alarms.
home.load_failed: The TAB-1 panel could not load: {message}
editor.missing_text: It was deleted, or it is no longer a TAB-1 dashboard.
editor.read_only_yaml: This dashboard is kept in a YAML file. You can look at it here, but changes have to be made in that file.
editor.read_only_auto: This dashboard is built automatically by Home Assistant, so there is nothing to change here.
editor.tablet_note: This is the tablet's screen. Dashboards are not sent to tablets yet.
editor.not_shown_one: 1 card on this page is not shown on the tablet.
editor.not_shown_many: {count} cards on this page are not shown on the tablet.
editor.empty_page: This page is empty. Cards you add appear here, the way the tablet will show them.
editor.empty_page_tablet: The tablet leaves out pages with no cards.
editor.screens_note: This page has more cards than fit on one screen, so the tablet splits it into {count} screens.
editor.nothing_selected: Press a card on the tablet picture to change it, or add a new one.
editor.page_not_shown: The tablet does not show this page, so there are no cards to change here.
editor.columns_title: This page is arranged in narrow columns
editor.columns_text: It was laid out in Home Assistant's own editor, so its cards stay inside columns. You can let cards use the whole screen instead. Their order stays the same.
editor.preview_failed: The tablet picture could not be updated: {message}
page.heading: This page
page.name: Page name
page.icon: Icon on the tablet's side bar
page.delete_text: The page and the cards on it are removed from this dashboard. Cards on it: {count}.
page.only_one: A dashboard needs at least one page.
page.old_preview_title: You no longer need this page
page.old_preview_text: This is the old "Tablet preview" page. The TAB-1 panel now shows the tablet's screen while you work, so this page does nothing. The tablet never shows it.
page.other_title: The tablet cannot show this page
page.other_text: It was made in Home Assistant's own editor as a kind of page the tablet does not support, so the tablet leaves it out.
list.title: Cards on this page
list.heading: Heading: {text}
warn.view_not_sections: The tablet cannot show this kind of page, so it is left out.
warn.strategy_not_supported: Part of this dashboard is built automatically by Home Assistant. The tablet cannot show that part.
warn.not_tab_element: This is not a TAB-1 card, so the tablet cannot draw it. Remove it, then add a TAB-1 card instead.
warn.unknown_component: This card needs "{detail}", which is not installed.
warn.invalid_card: This card's settings are not valid: {detail}
warn.needs_approval: This card can control locks or alarms and comes from your own folder, so it is switched off until you allow it under Advanced.
warn.params_incomplete: No device chosen yet, so this card shows example values.
warn.element_clipped: Part of this card does not fit at this size. Make the card bigger.
warn.card_too_wide: This card is wider than the space it is in, so it is drawn narrower.
warn.card_too_tall: This card is taller than the screen, so it is drawn shorter.
warn.section_split: This page has more cards than fit on one screen, so it continues on the next screen.
warn.over_budget_charts: A screen can show 4 graphs. This one is over the limit, so it is left out. Move it to another page.
warn.over_budget_arcs: A screen can show 4 dials. This one is over the limit, so it is left out. Move it to another page.
warn.over_budget_gradients: A screen can show 4 left-to-right colour fades. This one is drawn in a plain colour.
warn.too_many_pages: A dashboard can have 20 screens. The rest are left out.
warn.too_many_nav: The tablet's side bar has room for 8 pages. The others are reached by swiping.
warn.columns_differ: This page is not set to 3 columns in Home Assistant, so it looks different there than on the tablet.
warn.visibility_ignored: This has a "show only when" rule from Home Assistant's own editor. The tablet ignores the rule and always shows it.
warn.nested_section_ignored: Part of this page is nested in a way the tablet cannot show. That part is left out.
warn.view_extras_ignored: This page has badges, a header or a side column from Home Assistant's own editor. The tablet does not show them.
warn.invalid_options: This dashboard's TAB-1 settings are damaged, so the Midnight theme is used. Pick a theme to repair them.
warn.section_not_grid: Part of this page is a kind the tablet cannot show. That part is left out.
warn.old_preview: This is the old tablet preview card. You no longer need it.
picker.title: Add a card
picker.intro: These are the cards the tablet can show. Pick one, then choose the device it controls.
picker.intro_for: These cards can control {device}. The card you pick gets {device} straight away.
picker.intro_for_many: Each of these cards can control at least one of {device}. The card you pick gets as many of them as it can take. After that you are offered a card for the rest.
picker.none_help: Try the name of a card or a kind of device, such as Light, Thermostat or TV.
picker.locked: Switched off. Allow it under Advanced to use it.
pick.title: {card}: choose what it controls
pick.which.cover: Which blind, curtain or garage door?
pick.none_title: Home Assistant has nothing of this kind yet
pick.none_text: You can still add the card. It shows example values until you choose a device.
pick.many_hint: Choose one or more, up to {max}.
pick.skip_hint: The card shows example values until you choose a device.
form.name: Name on the card
form.name_helper: Leave empty to use the device's name.
form.size_odd: This card has an unusual size from Home Assistant's own editor. Change it here to give it a standard size.
form.size_columns: This page is arranged in narrow columns, so a card can be at most {max} wide here. Let the cards use the whole screen to make them wider.
form.theme_helper: Only for this card. The theme for the whole dashboard is under "Page and dashboard settings".
form.transparency_helper: 0 is solid. 100 shows only the page background.
form.accent_helper: Used for switches, sliders and buttons that are on, and to tint the card while its device is on.
form.order_helper: Cards fill the screen from left to right, then top to bottom.
settings.heading: This dashboard
settings.name: Dashboard name
settings.theme_helper: Colours for the whole tablet. A single card can use a different theme.
settings.sidebar_helper: Turn this on only if you also want to open this dashboard from Home Assistant's sidebar, for example to use it on a phone. The TAB-1 panel always lists it.
settings.delete_text: The dashboard and all its pages are deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.failed: That change could not be saved: {message}
sidebar.title: This dashboard is also in Home Assistant's sidebar
sidebar.text: From the sidebar it opens as a normal Home Assistant dashboard. Its Edit button there offers cards the tablet cannot show. You can always open it from the TAB-1 panel.
save.error_text: Your last change could not be saved: {message}. It is still here. Check your connection, then try again.
leave.title: Your last change is not saved yet
leave.text_error: If you leave, it keeps trying in the background while this browser page stays open. To try now, stay and press Try again.
leave.text_choice: It waits until you choose which version to keep. If you leave, you are asked again when you open this dashboard.
toast.card_added_for: Card added. Add a TAB-1 card for {device}.
toast.card_removed_for: Card removed. Add a TAB-1 card for {device}.
toast.remote: This dashboard was changed somewhere else. You are now looking at the newest version. Press Undo to go back to yours.
conflict.title: This dashboard was changed somewhere else
conflict.text: Another browser tab or another person saved a different version while you were making a change. Choose which one to keep. You can still undo afterwards.
conflict.unsure_title: Your change is not saved yet
conflict.unsure_text: The connection to Home Assistant was lost for a while, so the editor cannot be sure this is still the dashboard you were changing. Someone may have deleted it and made a new one in its place. Choose which version to keep. You can still undo afterwards.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: You only need this page if you add cards made by other people, or write your own.
advanced.folder_text: Community cards are TAB-1 cards made by other people. Each is a small file: put it in the folder below on your Home Assistant, then press "Look for new cards". Cards for Home Assistant's own dashboards, such as those from HACS, do not work on the tablet.
advanced.counts: Cards installed: {count}. Built in: {builtin}. From your folder: {user}.
advanced.reloaded: Done. Cards installed: {count}. Files with problems: {errors}.
advanced.user_none: There are no cards from your folder yet.
advanced.locks_title: Cards that control locks or alarms
advanced.locks_text: A card from your folder that can lock, unlock, arm or disarm stays switched off until you allow it here. Only allow cards you trust. If the card's file changes, it is switched off again.
advanced.locks_none: None of the cards from your folder control locks or alarms.
advanced.errors_text: These files were skipped. Your other cards are not affected.
a11y.canvas: Tablet screen. Each card is a button. Press one to change that card.
a11y.heading: Heading: {text}
preview.title: Tablet preview
preview.not_sent: Dashboards are not sent to tablets yet. This shows what a tablet would show.
preview.no_pages: This dashboard has no cards yet. Add some in the TAB-1 panel.
preview.admin_only: The tablet preview is only shown to administrators.
preview.not_tab: This is not a TAB-1 dashboard.
